name: vinktar
description: Error tracking for your app that your coding agent can read. Already on Sentry? Keep the SDK and change the DSN. Starting fresh? Ask your agent: "Set up Vinktar for my app." It adds the SDK and checks that errors arrive, no account needed first; you claim the project with one link when it is done. Then ask what broke, and it reads the stack trace, the release and what the user did before. Product analytics on the same users, free up to 50,000 errors a month.

interface.longDescription: Vinktar keeps a product's errors and its analytics events in one place. Your agent sets it up in your codebase: it installs the SDK for your stack, fetches the project's write key, defines each event it adds and checks what actually arrived. Then ask it about your errors and events: open issues with their stack traces, the release and what the user did before, trends, funnels and retention, or SQL when the question needs it. When you sign in you choose the workspace, the projects, and whether the agent may only read or also build and configure. It cannot delete events, errors, issues or projects, and every call it makes is listed on the AI agents page.
defaultPrompt: Set up error tracking for my app.
